# Town of Vershire municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Vershire, published results of the annual town meeting of April 11, 2026 (postponed from March; town website): Eileen Murphy was elected Moderator from the floor

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Nicole White-Fogarty (Chair), Vernal Stone, and Amy Record for Vershire's three-member board
Town of Vershire, published results of the annual town meeting of April 11, 2026 (postponed from March; town website): Nicole White-Fogarty won the three-year ballot seat 88-60 over Gene Craft

Town of Vershire, published results of the annual town meeting of April 11, 2026 (postponed from March; town website): Chelsea Parker won the one-year Town Clerk ballot seat with 169 votes; she had filled the vacancy left by Gene Craft's January 2026 resignation
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Chelsea Parker as Vershire's Town Clerk

Town of Vershire, 2026 Town Report: the 2026 Warning and the 2025 Town Officers page: Gene Craft held the treasurer's office with an elected term to 2027; he resigned in January 2026 and the Selectboard filled the vacancy by appointment

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names 'F Naomi Labarr' as Vershire's Town Treasurer (the town also advertised the post in May 2026)

sources.note: Town of Vershire, published results of the annual town meeting of April 11, 2026 (postponed from March; town website): Naomi LaBarr won the 2026 ballot seat with 167 votes (the same person the Selectboard appointed Treasurer)

Town of Vershire, published results of the annual town meeting of April 11, 2026 (postponed from March; town website): Debra S. Kingsbury won the two-year seat (164) and John Raynor the one-year seat (148); the three-year seat drew only scattered one-vote write-ins against 163 blanks, electing nobody, and is left without a membership

Town of Vershire, 2026 Town Report: the 2026 Warning and the 2025 Town Officers page: the listers' own report (signed Debra S. Kingsbury) records that Bonnie Strout and Allison Towle served the year as appointees after resignations; the officers page gives Raynor's form as John P. Raynor

Town of Vershire, 2026 Town Report: the 2026 Warning and the 2025 Town Officers page: lists three cemetery trustees -- Eleanor Zue (to 2028), Peggy Darrow (to 2026), and Rita French (to 2027); the trustees double as sextons

Town of Vershire, published results of the annual town meeting of April 11, 2026 (postponed from March; town website): Liva Vitols was elected from the floor to the three-year cemetery trustee seat (Darrow's term expired)

24 V.S.A. section 4323 permits a town to elect its planning commission; Town of Vershire, 2026 Town Report: the 2026 Warning and the 2025 Town Officers page: lists five commissioners -- Liana Horster, Michelle Massa, Eleanor Zue, Gregory Wilson (Chair), and Seann Cram

Town of Vershire, published results of the annual town meeting of April 11, 2026 (postponed from March; town website): Michelle Massa was re-elected and Martin Hale elected, each to a four-year term, from the floor

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Vershire justices of the peace: Benjamin 'Pat' Barnes, Margaret 'Peggy' Darrow, Bonnie Strout, Reva Seybolt, and Andrea Wasserman. The town report's justice table swaps Strout for Dawn Hancy, an equal-count name-swap; the certified slate governs, Strout's only documented resignation being from her appointed lister seat, and Hancy is recorded as the divergence
